actions.action: Merge changes against the tab’s loaded revision
actions.mechanism: Compare each field’s loaded value, local value, and latest server value; flag only divergent changes to the same field.
actions.implementation: Retain the loaded snapshot. On stale-save rejection, fetch the latest revision, preserve both drafts, and carry forward nonconflicting edits automatically.
actions.check: Test a stale tab edited after another tab saved: disjoint changes survive; divergent same-field changes require resolution.
actions.risk: Timestamps cannot reliably determine which edits should win.

actions.action: Replace the modal with field-level conflict resolution
actions.mechanism: Show conflicting fields in context, with labeled alternatives and text differences instead of a document-wide warning.
actions.implementation: For long text, offer an editable result beside both versions; for single-choice fields, offer explicit alternatives. Require confirmation for each conflict.
actions.check: Resolve text and choice conflicts entirely in one tab; verify untouched and automatically merged fields require no retyping.
actions.risk: Large text differences need accessible navigation and full-text views.

actions.action: Keep recoverable versions of every reconciliation attempt
actions.mechanism: A durable recovery history preserves text even when users choose another version or leave reconciliation unfinished.
actions.implementation: Checkpoint local and fetched text before applying resolutions. Provide a same-tab recovery panel that restores any alternative into the editable draft.
actions.check: Choose one version, reload, and restore the rejected text without copying between windows; simulate checkpoint failure and verify replacement is blocked.
actions.risk: Sensitive text needs appropriate storage protection and explicit retention controls.

actions.action: Recheck revisions when saving the resolved draft
actions.mechanism: Resolution remains provisional because another tab can save while the user reviews conflicts.
actions.implementation: Save explicitly as a draft using the reviewed revision. On rejection, preserve the resolution and repeat comparison against the newly fetched revision; never publish automatically.
actions.check: Save from another tab during review. Verify no overwrite, no lost resolution text, and no publication after successful draft saving.
actions.risk: Repeated concurrent saves can require additional review rounds.
